description: This file defines a transport stream implementation for Google Generative AI, including message conversion, request building, SSE chunk parsing, and stream management functions.

methods.name: isGemini3ProModel
methods.description: Checks if the model ID corresponds to a Gemini 3 Pro model.

methods.name: isGemini3FlashModel
methods.description: Checks if the model ID corresponds to a Gemini 3 Flash model.

methods.name: requiresToolCallId
methods.description: Determines if the model requires tool call IDs.

methods.name: supportsMultimodalFunctionResponse
methods.description: Checks if the model supports multimodal function responses based on its ID.

methods.name: retainThoughtSignature
methods.description: Retains or updates the thought signature based on incoming data.

methods.name: mapToolChoice
methods.description: Maps tool choice options to internal mode and allowed function names.

methods.name: mapStopReasonString
methods.description: Converts stop reason strings to internal stop reason types.

methods.name: normalizeToolCallId
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates tool call IDs.

methods.name: resolveGoogleModelPath
methods.description: Resolves the full model path from model ID.

methods.name: buildGoogleRequestUrl
methods.description: Constructs the request URL for Google API streaming.

methods.name: resolveThinkingLevel
methods.description: Determines the thinking level based on model ID and effort.

methods.name: getDisabledThinkingConfig
methods.description: Returns thinking config for disabled or limited thinking based on model type.

methods.name: getGoogleThinkingBudget
methods.description: Calculates the thinking budget based on model ID and effort.

methods.name: resolveGoogleThinkingConfig
methods.description: Resolves the thinking configuration for a model based on options.

methods.name: convertGoogleMessages
methods.description: Converts internal message format to Google API message format.

methods.name: convertGoogleTools
methods.description: Converts context tools to Google API function declarations.

methods.name: buildGoogleGenerativeAiParams
methods.description: Builds request parameters for Google Generative AI, including message conversion and config.

methods.name: buildGoogleHeaders
methods.description: Builds request headers including auth and model-specific headers.

methods.name: parseGoogleSseChunks
methods.description: Parses server-sent event chunks from Google API response.

methods.name: updateUsage
methods.description: Updates usage statistics from SSE chunk data.

methods.name: pushTextBlockEnd
methods.description: Pushes end events for text or thinking blocks in the stream.

methods.name: createGoogleGenerativeAiTransportStreamFn
methods.description: Creates the main transport stream function for Google Generative AI, managing request, response, and SSE parsing.
